title: 第14章寻访旧部孤臣寻援第15章驿馆藏杀死士暗袭
content_zh:
残霞浸满苍山，晚风卷着晚秋的霜气，扫过荒芜的古渡渡口。江水滔滔，拍打着斑驳的青石岸，碎光零落，一如四人此刻支离飘摇的心境。陈近仇、包不同、铁寻柳、花无艳并肩立在渡头，身前是奔流不息的江水，身后是满目疮痍的旧山河。方才一席道别，千言万语最终都沉落心底，化作无声的怅然。前路漫漫，各自背负残梦与旧责，要奔赴一场渺无希望的寻援之路，此别不知何日重逢，亦不知余生是否尚有归期。
花无艳一身素衣，裙角被晚风拂得轻轻翻飞，素来含笑温婉的眉眼间，此刻凝着一层化不开的清愁。她指尖轻捻一缕飘落的芦花，声音轻柔却带着笃定的沉冷：“此去天涯，各自珍重。山河倾覆，旧部星散，你们三人身负寻援重任，步步皆是险境。我留于此地，守着残余的方寸之地，打探朝堂动静，接应四方散落的志士，为你们守住身后退路。”
她生性通透柔韧，看似柔弱，实则最能沉得住气。乱世浮沉，她从不争锋芒，却始终是众人最安稳的后盾。此番别离，她主动留守断后，将最凶险的前路让与三人，独自扛起守望与接应的重担。陈近仇望着她清瘦却挺拔的身影，心中百感交集，拱手深深一揖：“无艳姑娘高义，我等铭记于心。待旧部归拢、大局初定，我等必归来与你汇合，绝不辜负今日托付。”
包不同站在一旁，素来桀骜不羁、出言无忌的他，此刻竟敛了一身狷狂。他素来随性洒脱，惯于辩驳世事、不肯屈从世俗规矩，可在山河破碎、同道别离的绝境面前，所有狂放都化作了沉重。他摩挲着腰间半块残缺的玉佩，那是旧日同袍结盟时的信物，边角磨损，纹路斑驳，承载着往昔无数热血朝夕。“我包不同一生，不认天命，不随大流，平生只信情义二字。”他抬眼，目光锐利坦荡，扫过三人，“此番寻访旧部，路途迢迢，人心难测，我依旧不改本心，不曲意逢迎，不妥协苟且。哪怕世人皆变，同道皆散，我亦守得住当年初心，寻得到散落同袍。”
铁寻柳沉默良久，一身玄色劲装衬得他身形愈发挺拔冷峻，周身萦绕着久经沙场的肃杀之气。他不善言辞，半生戎马，浴血沙场，早已习惯以刀枪代言，以行动立心。过往数年，他镇守边关，转战四方，见证过千万同袍血染疆场，也亲历过王朝崩塌、基业倾颓的绝望。他抬手按住腰间寒刃，刀刃微凉，透过掌心传来刺骨寒意，一如他此刻冰冷坚定的心境。他重重颔首，字字沉如金石：“沙场旧部，皆是生死相托的兄弟。无论隐匿山野、遁迹江湖，还是流落边关、蛰伏朝堂，我必一一寻回。凡尚存忠义之心者，尽数归队；若有背义投敌之辈，我亦亲手清算，绝不姑息。”
晚风更烈，吹乱四人鬓边发丝，江水呜咽，似为乱世别离悲叹。昔日四人并肩而行，闯险关、破危局、守忠义，共渡无数难关，从未有过分离。可如今大势已去，基业崩塌，朝野倾覆，唯有四散奔走，寻访旧部，收拢残力，方能于绝境之中寻一线翻盘生机。
花无艳微微颔首，眼底漾起细碎水光，却始终未曾落泪。她知晓男儿身负家国大义，从不会沉溺儿女情长与离别伤感，唯有坚守与奔赴，才是孤臣唯一的归途。“去吧。”她轻声道，“前路凶险，遇事三思，切莫逞强。我在此静候佳音，守到山河重清，守到诸君归来。”
陈近仇最后回望一眼渡口，回望这片满目萧瑟的山河，心中五味杂陈。他本是一介孤臣，年少怀志，立身朝堂，清正刚直，一心辅佐基业，守护苍生。奈何奸佞当道，权奸乱国，朝堂腐朽不堪，忠良惨遭屠戮，数代基业毁于一旦。如今朝堂沦陷，主上蒙尘，昔日并肩的忠臣义士死的死、散的散，唯有他们几人，背负着残破的忠义，于乱世中苦苦支撑。
“就此别过。”陈近仇沉声开口，语气庄重肃穆，“各自启程，各司其责。百日为期，无论成败得失，尽皆回归此地汇合。若百日之后，无人归来，便是身陨道消，余下之人，无需执念，可自行抉择，或隐于山野，或继续奔走，只求无愧本心、无愧忠义。”
三人再度与花无艳拱手作别，转身踏上不同的岔路。三条小路延伸向茫茫远山，隐入漫天暮色，恰似三条孤臣求索之路，自此分道扬镳，各自风雨兼程，奔赴一场未知的宿命。渡口只剩花无艳独立风中，望着三人渐行渐远的背影，直至身影消融在暮色云烟里，依旧久久伫立，不曾离去。
陈近仇所选之路，通往西南群山深处。西南多幽谷深林、险峰峻岭，地势隐秘复杂，远离朝堂纷争，是乱世之中绝佳的隐匿之地。当年大势未倾之时，他曾亲手举荐一批忠良志士，这群人不屑党争，不逐名利，素来刚正不阿，在朝堂倾轧初显时，便看透乱世征兆，早早辞官归隐，隐匿于西南山野之间。世人皆以为他们避世偷生、甘于平庸，唯有陈近仇知晓，这群人从未忘却家国忠义，只是静待时机，蛰伏待起。
他此行衣衫朴素，褪去了昔日朝堂官袍，一身布衣风尘仆仆，眉眼间却依旧留存着清正风骨。一路走来，满目皆是乱世凋敝之景。村落残破荒芜，田亩杂草丛生，道旁随处可见废弃的屋舍与累累荒冢。偶有残存的百姓，衣衫褴褛，面色枯槁，眼神麻木空洞，在乱世中苟延残喘。昔日繁华富庶的乡野，如今只剩萧条死寂，处处透着山河破碎的悲凉。
陈近仇一路缓步前行，心中感慨万千。他半生立身朝堂，鞠躬尽瘁，以为坚守正道、秉公履职，便能护得山河安稳、百姓安宁。可到头来，奸佞当道、谗言惑主，忠良蒙冤、社稷倾颓，终究是守不住盛世，护不住苍生。如今身为亡国孤臣，无官无职、无权无势，唯有一腔未凉热血、一身未改忠义，妄图寻访旧部、聚拢残力，于倾覆乱世中再挽狂澜。
行至深夜，山风凛冽，霜露深重，夜色漆黑如墨，笼罩连绵群山。陈近仇寻得一处废弃山庙，暂且落脚休整。山庙残破不堪，神像倾颓剥落，蛛网密布、尘埃厚积，早已无人祭拜。他拾来枯枝败叶，引燃一堆篝火，跳动的火光映亮他清瘦坚毅的面庞，也暖了些许深秋的寒凉。
火光摇曳间，往昔旧事涌上心头。当年朝堂之上，君臣议事、同僚共谋，一众志士意气风发，立誓匡扶社稷、安定苍生。那时人人心怀赤诚，坚信盛世永续、山河长安。可权欲熏心的奸党肆意构陷忠良，蒙蔽圣听、祸乱朝纲，一次次清洗朝堂、屠戮忠臣，昔日并肩的同道之人，或惨死刀下，或被贬流放，或隐世避祸，偌大朝堂，最终只剩奸佞横行、浊气弥漫。
陈近仇是最后一批坚守朝堂的孤臣，亲眼见证基业崩塌、山河倾覆，亲眼看着家国沦丧、苍生流离。若非心中尚存一丝执念，尚存重振山河的希冀，他早已随一众旧部，殉国赴义、了此残生。
次日天光微亮，霜气未消，陈近仇便起身赶路。山路崎岖难行，碎石荆棘遍布，一路艰辛跋涉，终于在日暮时分，抵达一处名为青溪谷的秘境。此地群山环抱，溪水潺潺，林木葱郁，隔绝了外界的乱世喧嚣，宛若世外桃源。谷中田舍整齐，炊烟袅袅，百姓安居乐业，风气淳朴平和，与外界的残破萧瑟判若两世。
踏入谷中，远远便见几位布衣老者临溪煮茶、闲谈度日。为首老者须发半白，眉眼清正，气度不凡，正是当年曾任御史中丞的苏砚臣，也是陈近仇昔日最信任的同僚、最默契的同道。苏砚臣望见陈近仇风尘仆仆的身影，眼中先是闪过一丝讶异，随即化作深沉的叹息，起身缓步相迎。
“近仇，你终究还是来了。”苏砚臣声音低沉，满含沧桑。
陈近仇拱手行礼，目光恳切：“苏兄，家国倾覆，山河沦陷，我辈身为旧臣，岂能坐视苍生流离、社稷沉沦？今日前来，不求苟安，只求聚拢旧部，再举义旗，匡扶山河，安定乱世。”

苏砚臣默然良久，转身引他入舍落座，命人奉上清茶。屋内简陋朴素，无半分奢华器物，尽显隐世淡泊。“我等归隐此地，并非贪生怕死、苟且偷安。”苏砚臣缓缓开口，语气满含无奈与悲凉，“当年朝堂腐朽，奸党势大，忠良尽遭迫害，我等若执意死守朝堂，不过是白白送命，徒留遗憾，于事无补。故而辞官归隐，暂避锋芒，只为留存忠义火种，静待来日翻盘之机。只是岁月流转，人心易变，数年隐世安逸，不少旧部早已倦了纷争、淡了初心，只愿安度余生，不愿再涉乱世风波。”
陈近仇闻言，心中早有预料，并无半分失望。他深知乱世浮沉，最易磨灭人心，安逸隐世最易消解壮志。“我知晓诸位难处。”他正色开口，目光澄澈坚定，“我并非强求众人出山，重蹈危局、赴死涉险。只是如今贼党掌权，暴虐无道，苛捐杂税层层盘剥，兵马横行肆意屠戮，天下苍生流离失所、饱受疾苦。我辈昔日食君之禄、担君之忧，身负家国重任、苍生之责，若一味隐世避祸、袖手旁观，与苟且偷生何异？今日寻访旧部，只为聚拢忠义之力，护乱世苍生，复山河清朗。愿随我奔赴大义者，我敬其赤诚；愿留谷安居者，我亦念其隐忍，绝不勉强。”
一番坦荡赤诚之言，字字铿锵，直击人心。屋中静坐的几位归隐旧臣，皆是当年朝堂清正之士，初心未泯、忠义未灭，听闻此言，眼底沉寂已久的热血再度翻涌。苏砚臣缓缓抬眼，目光坚定：“我虽年迈，筋骨衰退，无力驰骋沙场、披甲征战，却尚可执笔撰文、传檄四方，联络散落志士，安抚流离百姓。我愿随你出山，共赴大义！”
其余几位旧臣亦纷纷起身，拱手应和。有人擅长谋略、可定计策，有人精通民政、可安百姓，有人熟稔舆情、可传声望。众人虽无千军万马之勇，却各怀所长、皆有忠义。短短半日，青溪谷中隐匿的二十余名旧部尽数表态，愿随陈近仇出山，共寻复兴之路。
陈近仇心中暖意翻涌，连日赶路的疲惫尽数消散。他深知，这不是权势的聚拢，不是利益的结盟，而是乱世孤臣的并肩坚守，是破碎山河里不灭的忠义星火。他当即与众人商议布局，定下联络四方旧部、打探敌营虚实、安抚乱世流民的稳妥计策，步步为营，稳步推进，为后续大局积蓄力量。
另一边，包不同辞别众人后，一路北向，奔赴江湖草莽之地。他性情桀骜狷狂，平生最厌朝堂规矩、官僚束缚，素来与军中草莽、江湖义士交好。当年基业鼎盛之时，朝堂文官多轻视江湖武人，认为其行事粗鄙、不入正统，唯有包不同不拘门第、不执身份，广结江湖义士，收纳四方豪杰，组建了一支隐秘的江湖义旅。这支队伍不属朝堂编制，不受军令约束，只凭情义集结，守公道、扶弱小、护忠义，是潜藏在乱世中的一支隐秘力量。
包不同一路独行，步履轻快却心性沉稳。世人皆道他狂妄不羁、恃才傲物，凡事爱辩驳较真、不肯退让，看似随性肆意、不懂变通，实则他黑白分明、嫉恶如仇，最懂是非、最守情义。他从不盲从权势、不依附权贵，一生行事，只求本心无愧、情义不负。
北上途中，江湖乱象丛生。新朝势力借机扩张，四处清缴旧日忠义之士，打压江湖义旅，不少趋炎附势的江湖门派纷纷投靠新朝，为虎作伥，肆意欺凌弱小、屠戮义士，江湖道义崩塌、正邪颠倒。包不同一路所见，尽是忠义之人蒙冤、奸邪之辈横行，心中怒火层层积压。
行至黑风岭地界，恰遇一群新朝官兵联合附庸门派弟子，围堵屠戮一众旧部义士。对方人多势众、兵刃凌厉，一众江湖义士节节败退、伤亡惨重，眼看便要尽数殒命。包不同见状，不及多想，身形一闪，纵身入局。他手中无绝世神兵，一身武功却凌厉洒脱、招招狠辣，不循章法、不拘套路，恰好克制江湖旁门左道之术。
“世间公道，从不是奸邪贼辈说了算！”包不同朗声大喝，声音桀骜响亮，回荡山谷，“尔等依附逆贼、残害忠义，祸乱江湖、助纣为虐，今日便让你们知晓，江湖尚有正气，乱世仍存本心！”
他出手迅捷凌厉，进退自如，几番交手下来，便击溃数十名官兵、打退一众附庸弟子，救下残存的七八名旧部义士。这些人皆是当年他亲手收拢的江湖弟兄，乱世离散后依旧坚守本心，不肯投靠新朝，隐匿江湖伺机而动。众人见是包不同，又惊又喜，纷纷跪地行礼，眼底满是热泪与敬佩。
“包先生！我等以为此生再难与先生相见！”
content_en:
The remaining clouds filled Cangshan Mountain, and the evening wind carried the frosty air of late autumn and swept across the deserted ancient ferry. The river is surging, lapping at the mottled bluestone shore, and the scattered light is just like the four people's unsteady state of mind at this moment. Chen Jinchou, Bao Bubutong, Tie Xunliu, and Hua Wuyan stood side by side on the ferry, with the endless river in front of them and the devastated old mountains and rivers behind them. After saying goodbye just now, thousands of words finally fell into my heart and turned into silent sadness. The road ahead is long, each carrying residual dreams and old responsibilities, and heading on a hopeless road to find help. We don’t know when we will meet again, and we don’t know if we will return in the rest of our lives.
Hua Wuyan was dressed in plain clothes, and the corners of her skirt were fluttering gently in the evening breeze. Her eyes and brows, which had always been smiling and gentle, were now filled with a layer of sadness that could not be resolved. She gently twisted a wisp of falling reed flowers with her fingertips, and said in a soft voice but with a firm coldness: "We are going to the end of the world, each of us cherishes it. The mountains and rivers are overturned, and the old troops are scattered. The three of you have the heavy responsibility of finding help, and every step is in danger. I will stay here, guard the remaining square inch of land, inquire about the movements of the court, and meet the scattered patriots in all directions to guard your retreat."
She has a transparent and flexible nature. She looks weak, but in fact she is the most calm. In troubled times, she never competed for the upper hand, but was always the most stable support for everyone. After this separation, she took the initiative to stay behind and gave up the most dangerous road ahead to the three of them, shouldering the burden of watching and responding alone. Chen Jinchou looked at her thin but tall figure, with mixed feelings in his heart, and bowed his hands deeply: "We will bear in mind the righteousness of Miss Wuyan. When the old troops are reunited and the overall situation is initially decided, we will return to join you and we will never let down today's trust."
Bao BuTong stood aside. He had always been unruly and unruly, but at this moment he was actually full of arrogance. He had always been free and easy-going, accustomed to arguing with worldly affairs and unwilling to succumb to secular rules. But in the face of the desperate situation of broken mountains and rivers and separation of comrades, all his wildness turned into heaviness. He rubbed the half-broken piece of jade pendant around his waist, which was a token of the old alliance between his colleagues. The corners were frayed and the lines were mottled, carrying countless passionate days in the past. "I have lived a different life. I don't recognize fate, I don't follow the crowd, and I only believe in friendship." He raised his eyes, his eyes were sharp and magnanimous, and he scanned the three people. "This time I am looking for the old team, the journey is long, and people's hearts are unpredictable. I still won't change my heart, I won't bend my will to please, and I won't compromise. Even if the world changes and all my comrades are scattered, I can still keep my original intention and find my scattered comrades."
Tie Xunliu was silent for a long time. His black attire made his figure more upright and cold, and he was surrounded by a chilling air that had been on the battlefield for a long time. He is not good at words. He spent his whole life in the army and fought bloody battles. He has long been accustomed to speaking for himself with swords and guns and establishing his heart with actions. In the past few years, he has guarded the border, fought in all directions, witnessed the blood-stained battlefields of thousands of his comrades, and experienced the despair of the collapse of the dynasty and the collapse of the foundation. He raised his hand to hold the cold blade at his waist. The blade was slightly cold, and a biting chill came through his palm, just like his cold and determined state of mind at this moment. He nodded heavily, and his words were as heavy as gold and stone: "In the old battlefield, we are all brothers who rely on each other for life and death. Whether they are hiding in the mountains and wilderness, fleeing in the rivers and lakes, or living in the border areas, or dormant in the court, I will find them one by one. Anyone who still has a loyal heart will return to the team; if there are those who have betrayed their loyalty and surrendered to the enemy, I will personally deal with them and will never tolerate them."
The evening wind became stronger, ruffling the hair of the four people at their temples, and the river whimpered, as if they were lamenting parting in troubled times. In the past, the four of them walked side by side, overcoming dangers, overcoming dangerous situations, maintaining loyalty, and overcoming countless difficulties together. They were never separated. But now the situation is over, the foundation has collapsed, and the government and the opposition have been overturned. Only by running around, looking for old troops, and gathering the remaining strength can we find a chance to turn around in the desperate situation.
Hua Wuyan nodded slightly, her eyes sparkling with water, but she never shed tears. She knows that a man has the righteousness of his family and country, and will never indulge in the love between his children and the sadness of parting. Only persistence and running are the only way back for the lonely minister. "Go." She whispered, "The road ahead is dangerous., think twice when something happens, and don't show off. I will wait here quietly for good news, until the mountains and rivers become clear again, and until you all return. "
Chen Jinchou looked back at the ferry for the last time, looking back at the desolate mountains and rivers, with mixed feelings in his heart. He was originally a lonely minister. He was ambitious at a young age and established himself in the court. He was upright and upright. He devoted himself to assisting the foundation and protecting the people. However, traitors and sycophants are in power, powerful traitors are ruining the country, the court is in decay, loyal and good people are brutally slaughtered, and generations of foundations are destroyed in one fell swoop. Now that the court has fallen, the Lord is covered in dust, and the loyal ministers and righteous men who used to stand side by side are dead and scattered. Only a few of them, burdened with broken loyalty, are struggling to support themselves in the troubled times.
“Let’s just say goodbye. "Chen Jinchou spoke in a deep voice, with a solemn and solemn tone, "Each of us sets off and performs his own duties. For a hundred days, regardless of success or failure, everyone will return to this place to gather. If no one comes back after a hundred days, it means that the body has perished and the spirit has disappeared. The remaining people do not need to be obsessed and can make their own decisions, either hiding in the mountains or continuing to run, just to be true to their true heart and loyal to them. "
The three of them said goodbye to Hua Wuyan again and turned around and took different paths. The three paths extend towards the vast distant mountains, disappearing into the dusk sky, just like three lonely quest paths. Since then, they have gone their separate ways, each going through hardships and hardships, heading towards an unknown destiny. Only Hua Wuyan remained at the ferry, standing alone in the wind, watching the backs of the three people drifting away, until the figures melted into the dusk clouds, they still stood there for a long time, never leaving.
The road chosen by Chen Jinchou leads to the depths of the southwest mountains. The southwest is full of deep valleys, deep forests, and dangerous peaks. The terrain is secretive and complex. It is far away from the disputes in the court and is an excellent hiding place in troubled times. When the situation was not yet swayed, he personally recommended a group of loyal and lofty people. This group of people disdained party strife, did not pursue fame and fortune, and had always been upright. When the strife in the court first appeared, they saw the signs of troubled times, resigned early and retired to hide in the mountains and wilderness of the southwest. Everyone in the world thought that they were hiding from the world and living a mediocre life, but only Chen Jinchou knew that these people had never forgotten their loyalty to their family and country, but were just waiting for the opportunity, dormant and waiting to rise.
During this trip, he was dressed simply, having taken off his former court official robe, and was dressed in cloth worn by the dust, but he still retained his pure and upright character in his eyebrows. Along the way, we can see the scene of chaos and decay. The villages are dilapidated and deserted, the fields are overgrown with weeds, and abandoned houses and numerous graves can be seen everywhere along the roads. Occasionally, there are remnants of the people, with ragged clothes, haggard faces, and numb and empty eyes, struggling to survive in the troubled times. The once prosperous and prosperous countryside is now only desolate and dead, with the sadness of broken mountains and rivers everywhere.
Chen Jinchou walked forward slowly, feeling filled with emotions. He has been in court for most of his life and dedicated his life, believing that by adhering to the right path and performing his duties impartially, he can protect the stability of the country and the peace of the people. But in the end, when traitors are in power, slanderous words deceive the Lord, loyal people are wronged, and the country is in decline, ultimately it is impossible to maintain the prosperous age and protect the common people. Now, as a lonely minister of a subjugated country, he has no official, no position, no power and no power. He only has a heart that has not cooled down, and a body that has not changed his loyalty. He is trying to find his old troops, gather the remaining strength, and turn the tide in the troubled times.
As we walked until late at night, the mountain wind was biting, the frost and dew were heavy, and the night was as dark as ink, covering the mountains. Chen Jinchou found an abandoned mountain temple and settled down to rest temporarily. The mountain temple is dilapidated, the statues of the gods are fallen and peeling off, covered with cobwebs and dust, and no one has worshiped them for a long time. He picked up dead branches and leaves and lit a bonfire. The dancing firelight illuminated his thin and determined face, and also warmed up the coldness of late autumn.
As the firelight flickered, memories of the past came to mind. At that time, in the court hall, the monarchs and ministers discussed matters and colleagues conspired together. A group of people with lofty ideals were high-spirited and vowed to help the country and stabilize the people. At that time, everyone was sincere and firmly believed that the prosperous age would last forever and the mountains and rivers would be peaceful. However, the traitorous party who is obsessed with power wantonly framed the loyal and good, deceived the emperor, disrupted the court, cleansed the court and massacred loyal ministers again and again. People who were comrades who worked side by side in the past were either tragically killed by the sword, or were demoted and exiled, or secluded to avoid disaster. In the end, only the traitors were left running rampant in the huge court.The air is filled with turbidity.
Chen Jinchou was one of the last lone ministers to stick to the court. He witnessed with his own eyes the collapse of foundations, the overthrow of mountains and rivers, the loss of his family and country, and the displacement of his people. If he hadn't still had a trace of obsession in his heart and a hope of reviving the country, he would have joined a group of old soldiers to die for the country and die in righteousness.
The next day, the sky was slightly bright and the frost had not yet disappeared, so Chen Jinchou got up and started on his way. The mountain road was rugged and difficult to navigate, covered with gravel and thorns. After a hard journey, we finally arrived at a secret place called Qingxi Valley at sunset. This place is surrounded by mountains, gurgling streams, and lush forests. It is isolated from the hustle and bustle of the outside world and feels like a paradise. The farmhouses in the valley are neat and tidy, smoke is curling from cooking stoves, the people live and work in peace and contentment, and the atmosphere is simple and peaceful, which is completely different from the dilapidated and desolate outside world.
Stepping into the valley, you can see several old men in commoner clothes making tea and chatting by the stream. The old man at the head, with half-white beard and hair, clear facial features and extraordinary bearing, was none other than Su Yanchen, who had been the censor Zhongcheng back then. He was also Chen Jinchou's most trusted colleague and most tacit comrade in the past. When Su Yanchen saw Chen Jinchou's dusty figure, a trace of surprise first flashed in his eyes, and then turned into a deep sigh, he stood up and walked slowly to greet him.
"My close enemy, you are here after all." Su Yanchen's voice was low, full of vicissitudes of life.
Chen Jinchou bowed his hands in salute and looked sincerely: "Brother Su, my family and country have been overthrown, and mountains and rivers have fallen. As an old minister, how can I sit back and watch the people be displaced and the country be destroyed? I come here today not to seek peace, but to gather the old troops, raise the flag of righteousness again, help the mountains and rivers, and stabilize the troubled times."
Su Yanchen was silent for a long time, then turned around and led him to sit down, and ordered someone to serve him tea. The interior of the house is simple and simple, without any luxurious utensils, showing its seclusion and indifference. "We are living in seclusion here because we are not greedy for life and afraid of death, and we are living in peace." Su Yanchen spoke slowly, his tone full of helplessness and sadness, "Back then, the court was decayed, traitors were powerful, and all loyal and good people were persecuted. If we insist on sticking to the court, we will only die in vain, leaving only regrets. It doesn’t help. So I resigned and went into seclusion for a while, just to keep the fire of loyalty and wait for the opportunity to make a comeback in the future. However, as time goes by, people’s hearts change, and after a few years of living in seclusion, many of the old people have already become tired of the disputes and lost their original aspirations. They just want to live the rest of their lives in peace and do not want to be involved in the troubles of the world. "
When Chen Jinchou heard this, he had already expected it and was not disappointed at all. He knows that the ups and downs of troubled times are the easiest way to destroy people's hearts, and the ease and seclusion of the world are the easiest way to dissolve ambitions. "I know your difficulties." He spoke sternly, his eyes clear and firm, "I am not forcing everyone to come out of the mountain, repeat the dangerous situation, and risk their lives. It's just that now the thieves are in power and are tyrannical and cruel. They impose exorbitant taxes and exploit each other, and the soldiers and horses are rampant and wantonly slaughter. The people of the world are displaced and suffering. In the past, we were deprived of the emperor's salary and shouldered the responsibility. You are worried about your family and the people. If you just hide from the world and sit back and watch, what is the difference between me and me? Today I am looking for the old tribe to gather the power of loyalty to protect the people in the troubled times and restore the peace of the mountains and rivers. I respect those who are willing to follow me to the righteousness; I also remember their forbearance and will not force them to stay in the valley. "
A piece of frank and sincere words, every word is sonorous, directly touching people's hearts. The few retired ministers who were sitting quietly in the room were all upright men in the court. Their original intentions and loyalty were still intact. After hearing these words, the blood in their eyes that had been dormant for a long time surged again. Su Yanchen slowly raised his eyes with a firm gaze: "Although I am old, my muscles and bones are weakening, and I am unable to gallop on the battlefield or wear armor to fight, I can still write articles, send messages to all directions, contact scattered lofty ideals, and comfort the homeless people. I am willing to follow you out of the mountain to fight for the great cause!"
Several other old ministers also stood up and raised their hands in response. Some are good at strategy and can make strategies, some are proficient in civil affairs and can bring peace to the people, and some are familiar with public opinion and can spread reputation. Although everyone does not have the courage of thousands of troops, they all have their own strengths and are loyal. In just half a day, more than 20 former members of the group who were hiding in Qingxi Valley expressed their willingness to follow Chen Jinchou out of the mountain to find the road to revival together.
Chen Jinchou's heart surged with warmth.The fatigue of the journey has all dissipated. He knew very well that this was not a gathering of power or an alliance of interests, but the persistence of lonely ministers in troubled times, an undying spark of loyalty in the broken mountains and rivers. He immediately discussed the layout with everyone, and made a solid strategy to contact the old troops from all directions, find out the reality of the enemy camp, and appease the refugees in troubled times. He worked step by step and made steady progress to accumulate strength for the subsequent overall situation.
On the other side, Bao BuTong bid farewell to everyone and headed north to the wilderness of rivers and lakes. He had an unruly and arrogant temperament. He hated the rules of the court and the constraints of the bureaucracy. He had always been friendly with the reckless and righteous men in the army. At the time when the foundation was at its peak, most civil servants in the court looked down upon martial artists, thinking that they were vulgar and unorthodox. Only Bao BuTong, who did not stick to family or identity, gathered many martyrdoms, recruited heroes from all over, and formed a secret martyrdom brigade. This team does not belong to the imperial court and is not subject to military orders. It is gathered only on the basis of friendship, upholds justice, supports the weak, and protects loyalty. It is a hidden force hidden in troubled times.
Bao BuTong walked alone all the way, with brisk steps but a calm mind. Everyone in the world knows that he is arrogant and arrogant, loves to argue and be truthful in everything, and refuses to give in. He seems to be casual and wanton, and does not know how to adapt. He never blindly obeys power or relies on powerful people. He only acts with a clear conscience and does not betray his feelings throughout his life.
On the way north, chaos arose in the rivers and lakes. The power of the new dynasty took the opportunity to expand, confiscating old loyalists everywhere, and suppressed the righteous people in the arena. Many sects of the jianghu and sects who were in favor of the factions defected to the new dynasty one after another, working as collaborators, wantonly bullying the weak, and killing righteous people. The moral integrity of the arena collapsed, and good and evil were reversed. What Bao BuTong saw along the way was that loyal people were being wronged and evil people were running rampant, and the anger in his heart was building up layer upon layer.
When they reached the border of Black Wind Ridge, they met a group of officers and soldiers of the new dynasty who joined forces with disciples from the vassal sect to surround and massacre a group of righteous men from the old dynasty. The opponent had a large number of people and powerful weapons. All the heroes were retreating steadily and suffered heavy casualties. They were all about to die. When Bao BuTong saw this, he didn't think much, and jumped into the situation with a flash of his body. He does not have a unique magic weapon in his hand, but his martial arts is sharp, free and easy, with ruthless moves. He does not follow rules and routines, and he can restrain the heretical techniques of the world.
"Justice in the world is never decided by evil traitors!" Bao Tongtong shouted loudly, his voice resounding and loud, echoing in the valley, "You have attached yourself to traitors, harmed loyalty, brought trouble to the world, and aided the evil deeds. Today I want to let you know that there is still righteousness in the world, and you still have your true intentions in troubled times!"
He struck swiftly and fiercely, advancing and retreating freely. After several battles, he defeated dozens of officers and soldiers, repelled a group of vassal disciples, and rescued the remaining seven or eight loyalists from the old tribe. These people were all brothers in the martial arts world that he personally gathered back then. After being separated in the troubled times, they still stuck to their true intentions and refused to surrender to the new dynasty. They hid in the martial arts world and waited for opportunities. When everyone saw that it was Bao BuTong, they were surprised and happy. They all knelt down and saluted, their eyes filled with tears and admiration.
"Mr. Bao! I thought it would be difficult to meet Mr. Bao again in this life!"
